Subject: twistor theory | ID: 15114

Step 3. Applying the finite-rank interpolation theorem to \(V_{01300013}\), we obtain the norm bound in the mixed Lebesgue scale for the appropriate exponents.

Conclusion. Steps 1-3 yield the result via real interpolation and the uniqueness of the decomposition.
